tangerine-tag.$description: Tangerine Tag — Primary CTA buttons, 'Book a demo' pill — warm orange against near-white backgrounds signals action without urgency, echoing the palette of premium retail labels

midnight-ink.$description: Midnight Ink — Body text, borders — near-black with a barely perceptible blue undertone, softer than pure black for long-form reading

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary body text, descriptive copy, meta information

deep-slate.$description: Deep Slate — Dark surface backgrounds, card overlays in dark sections

carbon.$description: Carbon — Headings, icon fills, primary text — used at full weight for maximum legibility

stone.$description: Stone — Supporting body text, nav labels, secondary labels

pebble.$description: Pebble — Placeholder text, muted links, disabled states

ash.$description: Ash — Tertiary text, icon strokes, faint borders

fog.$description: Fog — Page background, section fills — the dominant surface of the entire site

snow.$description: Snow — Card surfaces, nav background, button fill for ghost variant

peach-whisper.$description: Peach Whisper — Decorative SVG fills, illustration accent highlights

dusty-rose.$description: Dusty Rose — Semantic accent — appears in hover or highlight states on certain interactive elements

pp-radio-grotesk-light.$description: All hero and section headings. Weight 400 in this geometric grotesque renders visually as 'light' — at 70px the type feels pencil-drawn rather than set, giving large-format headlines an editorial quality no system font can replicate. The signature typographic move of this site.

inter.$description: Navigation labels, body copy, input fields, UI labels, subheadings. Weight 400 for body, 500 for nav links and emphasis. The negative letter-spacing is tighter than Inter's default, compressing the text block slightly without feeling cramped.

inter-variable.$description: Tightly set inline body snippets, single-line descriptors. Line-height 1.00 means no leading — used for compact label-style text only.

inter-display.$description: Occasional heading contexts at small display sizes, card titles in feature sections.

sans-serif-system-fallback.$description: Icon labels, tooltip text, browser-level UI elements — not a designed choice.
